title: EventBus same-callback wrong-owner unregister isolation contract

contract.ownership_isolation: A plugin cannot unregister a shared callback owned by other plugins
contract.registry_preservation: A wrong-owner unregister does not modify any valid owner entries
contract.multi_owner_preservation: All valid owners remain independently registered
contract.delivery_preservation: All valid owner registrations continue receiving events
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful after a wrong-owner unregister attempt
contract.permission_enforcement: Register, unregister, and emit operations require the events permission
